cd /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json,re
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w59-20261001/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f1a2.json'))
for i,t in enumerate(d['payload']['translation_snapshot']):
    s,g=t['source'],t['target']
    f=lambda x:re.findall(r'%[-0-9.]*[a-zA-Z%]|#[A-Za-z_{}]+#|\[/?i\]',x)
    sl=[re.match(r'\t*',l).group() for l in s.split('\n')]; gl=[re.match(r'\t*',l).group() for l in g.split('\n')]
    if s.count('\n')!=g.count('\n') or sl!=gl or sorted(f(s))!=sorted(f(g)):
        print(i, s.count('\n'),g.count('\n'), sl, gl, sorted(f(s))==sorted(f(g)))
EOF
